# aidit

One local dashboard for every AI agent on your machine. Manage MCP configs and skills across Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and 20+ other tools. Localhost only, no cloud, no telemetry.

- Website / dashboard: <https://github.com/onur/aidit>
- Issue tracker: <https://github.com/onur/aidit/issues>
- Discussions: <https://github.com/onur/aidit/discussions>
- Security: see [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)

## Install

```bash
npx aidit start
```
